correctness.rationale: PASS — Reconstructed payoff-order preservation under the exact reflected-branch assumption: for every attainable local own-color fraction f, the admissible payoff orders agree with min(f/Λ,(1−f)/(1−Λ)). All strict-comparison sign changes for distinct rational fractions in F_n occur at Λ=f/(1+f−g), and evaluating each such boundary and every open interval midpoint gives an exhaustive real-peak partition. Independently built all K_{s,t} color-state graphs (s≤t, s+t≤6) and ran Kahn topological-cycle detection on 3,079 exact graph/composition/peak instances, 140,610 states and 216,828 improving edges, agreeing with the claimed unique K_{3,3}, (r,b,e)=(3,1,2), Λ>2/5 exceptional cycle. Recomputed the four-step labeled witness: red fractions 1→2/3, blue 1/3→1/2, with strict blue improvement precisely Λ>2/5. Distinguishable-agent cycles project to a color cycle; projected acyclicity suffices for the FIP conclusion. Scope requires two occupied colors, ≥1 vacancy, n≤6, connected complete bipartite graph and the specific source-symmetric utility, not arbitrary unimodal payoffs.
